items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Well, I had Peterson to look that up.

ctx.x: Did we see that one? I don't know that name. That's what I'm telling you. Oh, yeah. V-A-L-E-T-T-E. Yeah, Valette. Valette.
Well, I had Peterson to look that up. Peterson looked that up in the book about that Valette. He found it in his book. Made in Paris, France.
That's a nice, nice clarinet. Nice tone. Is that hard rubber or is it wood?
